title: 第5章 我叫白牧野第6章 同学们
lines: 第5章我叫白牧野
接下来两天，白牧野连书房都没出，整个人几乎都快要钻进那部符篆师宝典中去了。
解读、领悟、实践！
这些年他虽然一直在家自学，但他的学习习惯却不比任何一个学霸差。
一方面是白牧野自身足够优秀；另一方面，也得益于老头子这些年的教导。
使得白牧野有着远超绝大多数同龄人的自律！
但只是在学习方面。
至于其他方面……
书房已经成了战场，变得乱七八糟。
桌子上、地上，到处都是符篆用纸，那上面画着乱七八糟各种东西。
动物、植物、各种神秘的铭文和线条……至少有三四十张！
虽然很乱，但每一张符纸上的内容，看上去都特别精美！
哪怕只是单纯的线条，也给人一种神秘的美感。
白牧野这些年一直跟老头子学画，能让挑剔的老头子夸赞说还不错的画技，放在外面，其实已经可以登堂入室了！
天赋这种东西是羡慕不来的。
这就像有些人看上去从来不学习，也没怎么努力，似乎跟你差不多。
但一到考试，你就会发现人家其实是个学霸。
而你，只是个卷子瞎填都填不满的学渣。
被白牧野如同扔垃圾一样到处乱扔的这些符纸，如果被网络上正在寻找“神秘街头画家”的那群人看见，估计得疯。
如今已经有人开价十七万，只求一幅画。
人就是这样，越是得不到的，越觉得好。
假冒的倒是不少，都很快被识破。
于是网络上流传出许多关于街头画家的传闻。
有说他本身就是个富家子弟，来街头绘画不过是为了玩票；也有说他跟大明星秦冉冉原本就认识。
不然为什么这种大明星会一个人跑到街头去捧他的场？
还有人说神秘的年轻街头画家，其实是秦冉冉经纪人芳姐想要包装的新人！
是个小鲜肉，那些画也不是他画的，都是代笔！
芳姐：老娘要是能找到他就好了！
甚至还有一些名气说大不大说小不小的画家站出来抨击那位街头画家，认为他有辱艺术！
“艺术是能用金钱来衡量的吗？”
“艺术是无价的！跑到街头卖画，本身就是对艺术的一种巨大侮辱！”
当然，这种散发着酸臭味儿的声音，没几个人会在意。
倒是秦冉冉，像是跟白牧野杠上了。
从来没被人拒绝过的她这几天疯狂添加白牧野为好友。
之前是被拒绝，可这两天干脆连动静都没有了！
简直太过分了！
秦冉冉表面是个高冷的女孩，开演唱会和参加各种活动的时候惜字如金。
网络上流传的关于她的视频，也大多都是静静唱歌那种。
一身仙气儿，美艳无比。
但私底下，她却是一个大大咧咧不拘小节的姑娘。
content_en:
Chapter 5 My name is Bai Muye
In the next two days, Bai Muye didn't even leave the study. He was almost immersed in the Talisman and Seal Script Master's Book.
Interpret, understand, practice!
Although he has been studying at home these years, his study habits are no worse than any top student.
On the one hand, Bai Muye himself is good enough; on the other hand, he also benefited from the old man's teachings over the years.
This makes Bai Muye have self-discipline that far exceeds that of most of his peers!
But only in terms of learning.
As for other aspects...
The study has become a battlefield and become a mess.
There are talisman and seal papers everywhere on the table and on the floor, with all kinds of random things drawn on them.
Animals, plants, various mysterious inscriptions and lines... there are at least thirty or forty of them!
Although it is very messy, the contents on every talisman paper look particularly exquisite!
Even simple lines give people a mysterious beauty.
Bai Muye has been learning painting from the old man over the years, and he can make the picky old man praise his pretty good painting skills. If you put them outside, you can actually enter the house!
Talent is something you can't envy.
It's like some people never study or work hard, and they seem to be about the same as you.
But when it comes to the exam, you will find that he is actually a top student.
And you are just a scumbag who can't even fill up the paper.
These talisman papers that Bai Muye threw around like garbage would probably go crazy if they were seen by the group of people who were looking for the "mysterious street painter" on the Internet.
Now someone has offered 170,000 yuan for just one painting.
This is how people are, the less they can get, the better they feel.
There are quite a few fake ones, and they are all quickly spotted.
As a result, many rumors about street painters circulated on the Internet.
Some said that he was a kid from a rich family and came to the streets to paint just for fun; others said that he and the big star Qin Ranran knew each other from the beginning.
Otherwise, why would such a big star go to the streets alone to support him?
Some people also say that the mysterious young street painter is actually a newcomer that Qin Ranran’s agent, Sister Fang, wants to package!
He's a little kid, and those paintings were not painted by him, they were all ghostwritten!
Sister Fang: If only I could find him!
There were even some famous painters who came out to criticize the street painter, thinking that he insulted art!
“Can art be measured in money?”
"Art is priceless! Selling paintings on the street is a huge insult to art!"
Of course, few people would care about such a sour smell.
Qin Ranran, on the other hand, seemed to be at odds with Bai Muye.
Having never been rejected by anyone, she has been frantically adding Bai Muye as a friend in the past few days.
I was rejected before, but in the past two days there has been no movement at all!
It's simply too much!
Qin Ranran looks like a cold girl on the surface. She cherishes her words like gold when she holds concerts and participates in various activities.
Most of the videos about her circulating on the Internet are of her singing quietly.
She is full of fairy spirit and extremely beautiful.
But privately, she is a carefree and informal girl.
